class="font-medium text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-0">Get Started</span></div><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Models &amp; Pricing</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Cursor supports frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, SpaceXAI, and more. Pro, Pro Plus, and Ultra include two usage pools so you can pick the right balance of intelligence, speed, and cost. Start, our plan for developers in India, covers the Cursor Models pool.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="usage-pools"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#usage-pools" data-heading-base-id="usage-pools" aria-label="Copy link to usage-pools"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Usage pools</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are two separate usage pools, each resetting with your monthly billing cycle:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Cursor Models</strong>: Significantly more included usage for Cursor Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Other Models</strong>: The pool for third-party models, charged at the model&#x27;s API price. Pro, Pro Plus, and Ultra include this pool, with the option to pay for additional usage as needed. The Start plan does not include this pool.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Both pools are visible in your editor settings and on your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/usage" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">usage dashboard</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="cursor-models"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#cursor-models" data-heading-base-id="cursor-models" aria-label="Copy link to cursor-models"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Cursor Models</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Models pool includes Cursor Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On Teams and Enterprise plans, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cursor-router">Cursor Router</a> picks the model for each Auto request based on your optimization mode.</p>

<div class="not-prose mt-8"><p class="text-muted-foreground text-sm"><p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Opting in to regional data residency incurs a 10% uplift on Model pricing for eligible Models. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/privacy-and-data-governance">Privacy and Data Governance</a> for details on supported regions, Models, functions and data residency policies.</p></p></div>
<br class="my-4"/>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="plans"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#plans" data-heading-base-id="plans" aria-label="Copy link to plans"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Plans</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Pro, Pro Plus, and Ultra include unlimited tab completions, extended agent usage limits on all models, access to Bugbot, and access to Cloud Agents. Start is a lower-priced plan for developers in India that covers the Cursor Models pool and Cloud Agents.</p>

<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Since different models have different API costs, your model selection affects how quickly your included usage is consumed.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="start-india-only"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#start-india-only" data-heading-base-id="start-india-only" aria-label="Copy link to start-india-only"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Start (India only)</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start is available to developers in India. It costs ₹649 per month, tax inclusive, billed monthly in INR with UPI, credit card, or debit card. Every other individual plan displays its price before tax.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start includes generous usage of the Cursor Models pool, so you can run Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5 for daily building. On Start, all three models run in non-fast mode, and both Grok 4.6 and Grok 4.5 use a fixed medium effort level. You cannot change effort levels or enable Fast mode on Start. Upgrade to Pro or higher to choose effort levels and Fast mode.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start also includes <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cloud-agent">Cloud Agents</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cloud-agent/mobile">Cursor for iOS</a>, and plugins, MCP servers, hooks, and skills.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start does not include the Other Models pool, on-demand usage, Bugbot, Auto, Automations, or the Cursor SDK. Upgrade to Pro for those. Read the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/blog/cursor-start-india" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Start announcement</a> for more detail.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="how-much-usage-do-i-need"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-much-usage-do-i-need" data-heading-base-id="how-much-usage-do-i-need" aria-label="Copy link to how-much-usage-do-i-need"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How much usage do I need?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Daily Tab users</strong>: Typically stay within included usage</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Limited Agent users</strong>: Often stay within included usage</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Daily Agent users</strong>: Typically $60–$100/mo total usage</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Power users (multiple agents/automation)</strong>: Often $200+/mo total usage</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit" data-heading-base-id="what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit" aria-label="Copy link to what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What happens when I reach my limit?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">When you exceed your included monthly usage, you can either:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Add on-demand usage</strong>: Continue at the same API rates with pay-as-you-go billing</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Upgrade your plan</strong>: Move to a higher tier for more included usage</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On-demand usage is billed monthly at the same rates. Requests are never downgraded in quality or speed.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="teams"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#teams" data-heading-base-id="teams" aria-label="Copy link to teams"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Teams</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are two business plans: Teams and Enterprise (Custom). Teams offers two seat types: Standard ($40/user/mo) and Premium ($120/user/mo), where Premium adds 5x the Standard limits on Agent.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Team plans provide additional features like centralized team billing and administration, a team marketplace for internal rules, skills, and plugins, agentic code reviews with Bugbot, cloud agents and automations with shared team context, usage analytics, team-wide privacy mode enforcement, and SAML/OIDC SSO.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">We recommend Teams for any customer that is happy self-serving. We recommend <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=docs-models-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Enterprise</a> for customers that need priority support, pooled usage, invoicing, SCIM, or advanced security controls.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Learn more about <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/account/teams/pricing">Teams pricing</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="cursor-token-rate"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#cursor-token-rate" data-heading-base-id="cursor-token-rate" aria-label="Copy link to cursor-token-rate"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Cursor Token Rate</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On Teams and Enterprise plans, third-party model requests include a Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per million tokens. This rate applies on top of model API pricing for included usage, on-demand usage, and BYOK usage.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Token Rate applies when you select a third-party model directly, and when Auto routes to a third-party model. First-party Cursor models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt from the Cursor Token Rate.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="auto-modes"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#auto-modes" data-heading-base-id="auto-modes" aria-label="Copy link to auto-modes"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Auto modes</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Auto has three modes: Cost, Balance, and Intelligence. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cursor-router">Cursor Router</a> for how these modes work.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">All Auto modes bill at the list price of the model each request is routed to. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#model-pricing">Model pricing</a> for per-model rates. Third-party models also incur the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#cursor-token-rate">Cursor Token Rate</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="legacy-request-based-pricing"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#legacy-request-based-pricing" data-heading-base-id="legacy-request-based-pricing" aria-label="Copy link to legacy-request-based-pricing"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Legacy request-based pricing</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="max-mode"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#max-mode" data-heading-base-id="max-mode" aria-label="Copy link to max-mode"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Max Mode</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Max Mode is available only on legacy request-based plans. It extends a model&#x27;s context window beyond the default limit and is billed at the model&#x27;s API rate plus 20%. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/ai-features/max-mode">Max Mode on legacy plans</a> for details.</p>

class="font-medium text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-0">Get Started</span></div><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Models &amp; Pricing</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Cursor supports frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, SpaceXAI, and more. Pro, Pro Plus, and Ultra include two usage pools so you can pick the right balance of intelligence, speed, and cost. Start, our plan for developers in India, covers the Cursor Models pool.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="usage-pools"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#usage-pools" data-heading-base-id="usage-pools" aria-label="Copy link to usage-pools"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Usage pools</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are two separate usage pools, each resetting with your monthly billing cycle:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Cursor Models</strong>: Significantly more included usage for Cursor Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Other Models</strong>: The pool for third-party models, charged at the model&#x27;s API price. Pro, Pro Plus, and Ultra include this pool, with the option to pay for additional usage as needed. The Start plan does not include this pool.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Both pools are visible in your editor settings and on your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/usage" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">usage dashboard</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="cursor-models"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#cursor-models" data-heading-base-id="cursor-models" aria-label="Copy link to cursor-models"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Cursor Models</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Models pool includes Cursor Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On Teams and Enterprise plans, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cursor-router">Cursor Router</a> picks the model for each Auto request based on your optimization mode.</p>

<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="plans"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#plans" data-heading-base-id="plans" aria-label="Copy link to plans"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Plans</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Pro, Pro Plus, and Ultra include unlimited tab completions, extended agent usage limits on all models, access to Bugbot, and access to Cloud Agents. Start is a lower-priced plan for developers in India that covers the Cursor Models pool and Cloud Agents.</p>

<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Since different models have different API costs, your model selection affects how quickly your included usage is consumed.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="start-india-only"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#start-india-only" data-heading-base-id="start-india-only" aria-label="Copy link to start-india-only"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Start (India only)</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start is available to developers in India. It costs ₹649 per month, tax inclusive, billed monthly in INR with UPI, credit card, or debit card. Every other individual plan displays its price before tax.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start includes generous usage of the Cursor Models pool, so you can run Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5 for daily building. On Start, all three models run in non-fast mode, and both Grok 4.6 and Grok 4.5 use a fixed medium effort level. You cannot change effort levels or enable Fast mode on Start. Upgrade to Pro or higher to choose effort levels and Fast mode.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start also includes <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cloud-agent">Cloud Agents</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cloud-agent/mobile">Cursor for iOS</a>, and plugins, MCP servers, hooks, and skills.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Start does not include the Other Models pool, on-demand usage, Bugbot, Auto, Automations, or the Cursor SDK. Upgrade to Pro for those. Read the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/blog/cursor-start-india" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Start announcement</a> for more detail.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="how-much-usage-do-i-need"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-much-usage-do-i-need" data-heading-base-id="how-much-usage-do-i-need" aria-label="Copy link to how-much-usage-do-i-need"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How much usage do I need?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Daily Tab users</strong>: Typically stay within included usage</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Limited Agent users</strong>: Often stay within included usage</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Daily Agent users</strong>: Typically $60–$100/mo total usage</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Power users (multiple agents/automation)</strong>: Often $200+/mo total usage</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit" data-heading-base-id="what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit" aria-label="Copy link to what-happens-when-i-reach-my-limit"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What happens when I reach my limit?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">When you exceed your included monthly usage, you can either:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Add on-demand usage</strong>: Continue at the same API rates with pay-as-you-go billing</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Upgrade your plan</strong>: Move to a higher tier for more included usage</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On-demand usage is billed monthly at the same rates. Requests are never downgraded in quality or speed.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="teams"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#teams" data-heading-base-id="teams" aria-label="Copy link to teams"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Teams</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are two business plans: Teams and Enterprise (Custom). Teams offers two seat types: Standard ($40/user/mo) and Premium ($120/user/mo), where Premium adds 5x the Standard limits on Agent.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Team plans provide additional features like centralized team billing and administration, a team marketplace for internal rules, skills, and plugins, agentic code reviews with Bugbot, cloud agents and automations with shared team context, usage analytics, team-wide privacy mode enforcement, and SAML/OIDC SSO.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">We recommend Teams for any customer that is happy self-serving. We recommend <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=docs-models-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Enterprise</a> for customers that need priority support, pooled usage, invoicing, SCIM, or advanced security controls.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Learn more about <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/account/teams/pricing">Teams pricing</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="cursor-token-rate"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#cursor-token-rate" data-heading-base-id="cursor-token-rate" aria-label="Copy link to cursor-token-rate"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Cursor Token Rate</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On Teams and Enterprise plans, third-party model requests include a Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per million tokens. This rate applies on top of model API pricing for included usage, on-demand usage, and BYOK usage.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Token Rate applies when you select a third-party model directly, and when Auto routes to a third-party model. First-party Cursor models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt from the Cursor Token Rate.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="auto-modes"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#auto-modes" data-heading-base-id="auto-modes" aria-label="Copy link to auto-modes"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Auto modes</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Auto has three modes: Cost, Balance, and Intelligence. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/cursor-router">Cursor Router</a> for how these modes work.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">All Auto modes bill at the list price of the model each request is routed to. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#model-pricing">Model pricing</a> for per-model rates. Third-party models also incur the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#cursor-token-rate">Cursor Token Rate</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="legacy-request-based-pricing"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#legacy-request-based-pricing" data-heading-base-id="legacy-request-based-pricing" aria-label="Copy link to legacy-request-based-pricing"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Legacy request-based pricing</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="max-mode"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#max-mode" data-heading-base-id="max-mode" aria-label="Copy link to max-mode"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Max Mode</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Max Mode is available only on legacy request-based plans. It extends a model&#x27;s context window beyond the default limit and is billed at the model&#x27;s API rate plus 20%. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/ai-features/max-mode">Max Mode on legacy plans</a> for details.</p>
